svg.title: Khedival Cairo facade 01 — corner cupola and raised pediment
svg.desc: Source-informed vector elevation based on the photographed visible face. Curved left corner, ribbed onion cupola with lantern and three cartouches, broad concave-shouldered central pediment, four tall window tiers, grouped iron balconies, continuous lowest terrace rail and open arcade. No hidden face or measured dimensions are inferred.

g.aria-label: Ribbed onion cupola with lantern and oval cartouches
Large concave-sided raised pediment with fluted panel and oval crest
Upper parapet with repeated iron swag panels
Four window tiers with source-specific balcony grouping
Continuous hourglass baluster terrace rail; no individual balconies on lowest tier
